cases.query: I edited three files on main. Open a PR and turn on auto-merge.
expected_behavior: Creates a feature branch named type/kebab-desc instead of committing on the default branch
Adds files by name and never runs git add .
Rebases onto origin default before the first push
Queries the forge for the real merge state and reports URL, pipeline status and whether auto-merge is armed

cases.query: Open an MR on this GitLab repo and queue it to merge when the pipeline passes.
expected_behavior: Arms auto-merge through the API with sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD), not glab mr merge
Verifies state, merge_when_pipeline_succeeds and detailed_merge_status from the API rather than the CLI output
